caveats.note: India's CEPA tariff schedule (Annex 2A) lists this product under its older HS 2017 code 8517 12 11.
'+' in the rule is read as 'and' (both tests must pass). The agreement does not define '+', so this is Mansha's interpretation.
Operations and final manufacture are the exporter's own declaration.
A product that only undergoes minimal operations (Art. 3.5.1 a-q) does not originate, even if it meets its product-specific rule.
By interpretation, de minimis helps only the tariff-shift part of a rule, not the VA percentage.
Value addition may be calculated by build-down or build-up; 'Direct labour cost' and 'direct overhead cost' are not defined in the agreement.
The agreement does not say whether the build-down and build-up methods use the same threshold, apart from the 5-point Ex-Works adjustment.
